source: 11. How should you choose top-k, and why can retrieving more passages make the final answer worse? [Intermediate - Context] Top-k is a context-budget decision, not a retrieval constant. Raising k may improve the chance that supporting evidence is present, especially when the retriever’s ranking is imperfect. But every additional passage can add irrelevant, redundant, conflicting, or lower-quality text. That increases input cost and may make evidence harder for the generator to identify. Self-ZXNAME0000XZ specifically motivates adaptive retrieval partly because blindly retrieving a fixed number of passages can be unhelpful. The correct k depends on candidate recall curves, reranking quality, average passage size, model context behavior, and answer type. Evaluate retrieval recall at several depths and then evaluate generation with the actual packed context. Often the right design is to retrieve more candidates cheaply, rerank them, deduplicate them, and pass a smaller evidence set to the model rather than simply increasing prompt
zh: 11. 你应该如何选择top-k，为什么检索更多的段落会使最终的答案变得更糟？ [中级 - 上下文] Top-k 是上下文预算决策，而不是检索常量。提高 k 可能会提高支持证据出现的机会，特别是当猎犬的排名不完美时。但每一个额外的段落都可能添加不相关、冗余、冲突或质量较低的文本。这会增加投入成本，并可能使生成者更难识别证据。 Self-ZXNAME0000XZ 特别激励自适应检索，部分原因是盲目检索固定数量的段落可能没有帮助。正确的 k 取决于候选召回曲线、重新排序质量、平均段落大小、模型上下文行为和答案类型。评估多个深度的检索回忆，然后评估使用实际打包上下文的生成。通常，正确的设计是以低成本检索更多候选者，对它们重新排序，删除重复项，并将较小的证据集传递给模型，而不是简单地增加提示
